item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge will strengthen slightly in the next couple of days. The weather will be very hot with a few showers over southeastern China. The area of low pressure now over the central part of the Philippines will enter the South China Sea tomorrow, and move towards the northern part of the South China Sea over the weekend, but its development and movement remain uncertain. The associated showers and thunderstorms are expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early next week. Besides, another area of low pressure over the western North Pacific may develop gradually in the next few days, it will be more likely to move towards the seas near Taiwan.
